access: ReadProcessMemory through existing Hypervisor; no game writes, injection, hooks or game calls.
discovery: Installed IL2CPP version 31 metadata plus native getter disassembly, checked against the running game. Three RIP-based roots and four layout guards; all seven patterns have exactly one executable-section match in both disk and live images.

singleton_layouts.game_and_state: Global-namespace SingletonMonoBehaviour<T>: class + 0xB8 -> statics; instance at +0x8, lock at +0x0.
singleton_layouts.globals: Nosebleed.Core.Singletons.SingletonMonoBehaviour<Globals>: method slot -> MethodInfo +0x20 class -> +0xC0 generic context -> +0x10 class -> +0xB8 static fields -> +0 instance. Globals has PlayerRunSettings+0x20 and DungeonVariableAsset+0x38.

fields.GameStateManager: CurrentState+0x30, IsTransitioning+0x34; 1 main menu, 2 village/CharacterSelect, 3 game, 4 tutorial.
fields.GameModel: Player+0x58, Dungeon+0x60, kills IntAsset+0x48, runEnded+0xA0, GameStateMachine+0x80.
fields.PlayerModel: coins IntAsset+0x80, stats+0x138, XP IntVariable+0x178, next XP+0x180, level+0x188, combo+0x190, turn+0x198, totalXP Int32+0x170.
fields.PlayerStats: Health SimpleStat+0x18, Armor+0x20, Mana+0x60, startingMana IntAsset+0x10.
fields.SimpleStat: current FloatAsset+0x10, maximum FloatVariable+0x20. Asset numeric value+0x18; managed variable numeric value+0x10.
fields.hand: Player+0xB0 -> HandPileModel+0x28 -> CardPileModel+0x38 -> List<CardModel>. CardModel config+0x38 -> AssetId+0x58.
fields.other_piles: Draw wrapper+0xA8 then CardPile+0x68; Discard wrapper+0xC0 then CardPile+0x80. Both use CardPileModel list+0x38 and player owner+0x40.
fields.characters: PlayerRunSettings+0x78 -> List<FccConfig>; index 0 explicitly marked main FCC by game metadata. Config AssetId+0x58.
fields.floor: DungeonModel completedFloors+0xB0 modulo DungeonConfig.GenerationConfig+0x80 / Floors list+0x58, then +1 for display.

live_checks.run_placeholders: All empty; previous map, party, stats and cards removed.

consistency: Snapshot records all read ranges and validates them again before returning, including roots, Unity wrappers, class names, scalar values, list storage/count/version and card ownership. No previous snapshot cache. Pattern cache is bound to process ID, module base and size; missing/ambiguous signatures are rejected.

tests.live_harness: Invokes the production VC.ReadSnapshot and VC.GeneratePlaceholders without initializing Discord. Actual Discord client display was not validated.

limitations: Verified on the installed Steam build; future builds may need pattern or layout updates.
Only the listed party/dungeon and card change were live-tested; all named assets are not a claim of complete gameplay test coverage.
PlayerCoins and CardPileCount contain fixed relative CALL operands to distinguish generated clones; they remain ASLR-safe but build-dependent.
Floor semantics follow the native getter; a floor transition was not live-tested.
No meaningful maximum mana cap is exposed; startingMana is a separate value.
